_readme: Hand-edited trip details. Edit this file, then run: node scripts/build-data.mjs

base.name: The Airbnb
base.note: Rough spot from the Airbnb map: beside Lemezkuckó record shop on Király utca, by the Király utca tram stop (trams 4 and 6). The exact address comes once Aaron has it.

plan.title: Thursday
plan.theme: Arrive, pints, Fradi under the lights

items.title: Wheels down at BUD
items.sub: The crew lands at Terminal 2. Aaron's arrival time is TBC.

items.title: Into town
items.sub: 100E express bus to Deák tér (2,500 HUF, tap your card at the door), then M1 two stops to Oktogon and a 5-minute walk. Or split two Bolts straight to the door.

items.title: Drop bags at the Airbnb
items.sub: Beside Lemezkuckó record shop on Király utca, by the tram 4/6 stop. Exact address and check-in time TBC.

items.title: First pint and a lángos
items.sub: Szimpla is calm at this hour. Karaván street food is next door.

items.title: Head to Groupama Aréna
items.sub: Tram 4 or 6 to Corvin-negyed, then the M3 (blue) to Népliget. About 25 minutes from the flat. Bring your passports.

items.title: Ferencváros v Viktoria Plzeň
items.sub: Europa League. Kick-off 21:00 (20:00 UK).

items.title: Everyone else: Jewish Quarter crawl
items.sub: Instant-Fogas, Mazel Tov and Doboz are all within a few minutes of each other.

items.title: Regroup in District VII
items.sub: Instant-Fogas for the big rooms and dancefloors, Lámpás for a live band, or Szimpla if you missed it earlier.

items.title: Proper breakfast
items.sub: The kart track is a long way from any food. Eat first.

items.title: Bolts to Mogyoród
items.sub: Two cars, 25–35 min, around 12,000–14,000 HUF each. Aim to arrive by 11:30.

items.title: Go-karting at the Hungaroring
items.sub: Closed shoes. Nobody drinks before. Loser buys the first round.

items.title: Filippo's free morning
items.sub: Széchenyi Baths or the Basilica dome while the others crash into each other.

items.title: Back in town for a late lunch
items.sub: Cheap Hungarian canteen food or Bors' soups and baguettes.

items.title: Head to the MTK ground
items.sub: Tram to the Hidegkuti Nándor Stadion stop, or a Bolt in 10–15 min. André Rieu is on at the MVM Dome, so traffic will be heavy.

items.title: Gates open at MTK
items.sub: In from 18:00. Grab a beer and a sausage.

items.title: MTK Budapest v Vasas
items.sub: NB I. Kick-off 20:00 (19:00 UK) per your booking. Two fixture sites now say Sat 17 Oct 17:00, so check your tickets.

items.title: Rock bar night
items.sub: Barhole for metal and punk, Lámpás for live bands, then Instant-Fogas until late.

items.title: Soak it off at Széchenyi
items.sub: Outdoor hot pools in City Park. Buy a timed ticket online to skip the queue.

items.title: Lángos at the Great Market Hall
items.sub: Food stalls upstairs. Expect it to be busy on a Saturday.

items.title: Castle District, or go shooting
items.sub: Fisherman's Bastion and the Hospital in the Rock bunker, or the Churchill shooting range.

items.title: Sunset from the Citadella
items.sub: Sunset is about 17:53. The whole city lights up below you.

items.title: Big group dinner
items.sub: Book ahead for a table of lads on a Saturday.

items.title: Sparty, or the ruin bars
items.sub: The Széchenyi bath party is listed for tonight and sells out. Book it, or do Szimpla and A38.

items.title: Szimpla Sunday farmers' market
items.sub: Breakfast in the original ruin bar, with sausages and pastries from the stalls.

items.title: Hangover brunch
items.sub: Eggs, coffee and silence.

items.title: Order the Bolts
items.sub: Order now so the cars arrive as you leave.

items.title: Leave for the airport
items.sub: Latest sensible departure: 12:45 by Bolt (about 30 min on Sunday roads) or 12:15 on the 100E.

items.title: At BUD, no later than this
items.sub: Terminal 2. Duty-free pálinka for the hangover home.
